scope: Node.js module integration with synthetic state and deferred mocked router; no browser UI or physical GPS

results.name: State machine allows documented active navigation transitions and rejects illegal transition
A late reroute result cannot overwrite a user stop
A late reroute result is discarded after GPS signal loss
A late reroute result cannot overwrite an arrival state
A reroute result is discarded if the planned route changes while calculation is pending
A current reroute result is accepted while navigation remains valid
Reroute failures only set OFF_ROUTE when the original navigation is still current
Release cache and version identifiers are aligned to current Batch 47
